rank64_role: higher-rank reference; not a full-rank update
rank_control: alpha/r fixed at 4.0; target modules, optimizer, edit streams, and checkpoints matched
reporting: All ten predeclared 250-edit confirmation orderings are retained at ranks 8, 16, and 64. Each rank uses its coefficient frozen on two disjoint 100-edit development streams. Paired bootstrap intervals use 10,000 resamples. Low-rank advantage is the predeclared difference in SSR gain relative to the rank-64 reference.
